scope: Actual styled KeeperLaneStrip over a synthetic inventory in headless Chromium. No backend, live Keeper, inventory store, or SSE refresh.
checks: a large inventory mounts only the rows near the list viewport
the last server row is reachable by scrolling and acts on its own address
keyboard focus moves to the list when the focused row leaves the window
a row opened by the operator is still open after it leaves the window and returns
another Keeper starts at its first row with nothing open
